instruction.text: This is a map of the Caribbean. Select the coffee bean to learn more.

hint.label: Coffee cherries
hint.text: Coffee cherries are the fruits of coffee plants. Inside them, you will find the seeds, which are more commonly called coffee beans!

atoms.b: The Blue Mountains of Jamaica are famous for producing premium coffee. The ((++high low)) altitude and thick mist protects the plants from high temperatures and direct sun, allowing the coffee cherries to ripen slowly.
The Blue Mountains also have rich volcanic ((++soil dust)), plenty of rainfall and the right amount of humidity, creating ideal conditions for coffee plants to thrive.

Caribbean islands such as Jamaica are located within the Bean Belt. This is a region circling the ((++middle top)) of the Earth around the tropics that produces most of the coffee consumed in the world today.

feedback.finish: The Dominican Republic has the largest economy in the Caribbean and Central America. This is largely due to the export of natural resources.

atoms.a: One of the largest gold mines in the world can be found in the Dominican Republic.
Millions of kilograms of sea salt are shipped by the Dominican Republic every year.
The Dominican Republic is one of the top 10 producers and exporters of cocoa products.
The Dominican Republic is the world’s largest producer of organic bananas.

atoms.b: El Yunque is a cloud forest in Puerto Rico. This means it sits at such a ((++high low)) altitude that it’s always wrapped in a dense, low-lying fog.
atoms.sound: El Yuhn-kay is a cloud forest in Puerto Rico. This means it sits at such a high altitude that it’s always wrapped in a dense, low-lying fog.

atoms.b: The forest is one of the rainiest places on Earth, with some parts receiving over six metres of rain annually. This creates many beautiful rivers and ((++waterfalls glaciers)).
The forest is the natural habitat of the coquí tree frog, which is known for its high-pitched ((++chirp laugh)) that can be heard at night.

instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Trinidad and Tobago is a twin-island country situated in the southern Caribbean. Trinidad is much larger and more populous, while Tobago is smaller and a lot quieter.
Trinidad is more industrialised and has a larger economy, acquiring wealth through its massive oil and natural gas reserves. It has some mountains in the north but is otherwise mostly flat.

In contrast, Tobago is a mountainous island and has a smaller population. It is a nature paradise, with protected forests, sandy beaches and excellent diving spots. Therefore, its economy is more focused on tourism.

atoms.a: What is one difference between Trinidad and Tobago?
Which two factors make Trinidad better suited for industry?
Which factor contributes the most to Tobago’s economy?
